title: Promise and Garden Anew
author: Jude Nystrom
blurb: Paloma Thackeray, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
